episodes.title: Who'll Be The Next In Line?
episodes.summary: Meet Lady Jane Grey. Brilliant, but more usefully, beautiful. And about to have the worst day of her life. (So far.)

episodes.title: Wild Thing
episodes.summary: What's worse: when you have the raging horn for an unmitigated scoundrel? Or when he has a deep dark secret that could get you both killed?

episodes.title: With A Girl Like You
episodes.summary: Midnight quests in the woods, spanking, feasts, duels, murder and snogging. This episode has it all.

episodes.title: Bluebird Is Dead
episodes.summary: Jane is Queen and people keep trying to kill her. Pass the wine.

episodes.title: I'm Gonna Change the World
episodes.summary: Mary is coming for Jane's crown. Frances is coming for Guildford. And the nobility is coming to get hammered at Jane's Coronation Banquet.

episodes.title: I Feel Free
episodes.summary: Missing: the roguish consort to the Queen of England. If you have any idea as to his whereabouts, do let us know.

episodes.title: Another Girl, Another Planet
episodes.summary: Jane is on trial for treason. And Guildford, Edward and Fitz are determined to save her. Typical men.

episodes.title: God Save The Queen
episodes.summary: Our intrepid heroine might lose her head... but she won't lose her cool.
